title: Cat Retaliation
description: When a player attacks a cat, the cat will retaliate by biting and scratching the attacker.
body:
# Cat Retaliation

A Fabric mod for Minecraft that makes cats fight back when attacked. They bite and scratch!

## Features

- When a player attack a cat, it will run and attack the player.
- Adds a more dynamic and realistic behavior to cats in Minecraft.

## Requirements

- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) version 0.16.9 or higher
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- Minecraft 1.21.4
- Java 21 or higher

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for your Minecraft version.
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) into your `mods` folder.
3. Place the `Cat Retaliation` mod into your `mods` folder.
4. Launch Minecraft with the Fabric profile.

## Note

This mod is designed for the Fabric mod loader. It is not yet compatible with Forge or other mod loaders.

Enjoy having more feisty cats in your Minecraft world!
